# TAP Protocol

> TAP begins with deploy, mint, and transfer, then opens into authorities, peer-to-peer experiences, mass sends, and decentralized token mechanics.

## Public experience

- Home: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/tap/
- Discover: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/tap/reference.html
- Get started: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/tap/guide.html
- Bitcoin Universe: https://inscribe.bitcoinuniverse.io/

## The experience

- Launch: Create a token identity and define its supply and mint personality.
- Collect: Mint under the token’s terms and hold it in a compatible wallet.
- Connect: Transfer, coordinate, and explore richer TAP-enabled experiences.

## In plain language

- Basic actions: Deploy, mint, and transfer form the familiar TAP foundation.
- Transferables: A transfer becomes an inscription that is sent to its destination.
- Expressive tickers: TAP supports a broad visual character space for identities.
- Extensions: Compatible experiences can add authorities, P2P, DMT, and more.

## User safety

TAP transfers and extensions depend on compatible wallet and service support. Protect transferable inscriptions from accidental spending and verify the exact action, destination, and fees before signing.

## Community resources

- Explore TAP: https://docs.tap-protocol.com/
- See TAP’s core experiences: https://docs.tap-protocol.com/functions/quickstart
